title: Grogoni Android release manifest
description: Describes the currently published, signed Android release offered from the /install page. When `release` is null no native install is offered. See apps/web/src/android-release.ts for the runtime validation that mirrors this schema.

packageName.description: Must equal the production Android application id.

downloadUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL of the signed APK on the Grogoni origin.

sha256.description: Colon-separated uppercase SHA-256 fingerprint of the APK artifact.

minSdk.description: Minimum supported Android API level, for guidance only.
